final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 3]; rule=device is OFF if (object 0 is present with <2 other objects) or (object 3 is present without both object 1 and object 2); otherwise, device is ON
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 5, object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3]; rule=the device turns on if object 4 is present, object 5 is present, or at least four of objects 0–3 are present.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 4, object 7]; rule=at least one of object 1, object 4, or object 7 must be present
Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 3, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if at least one of these three objects is present
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=at least one of these three objects must be present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if at least one of object 0, object 1, or object 6 is placed on it.
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 5, object 7]; rule=the device turns on if at least one of objects 4, 5, or 7 is placed on it.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on if object 4 is present alone, or there are at least two objects including at least one of 0, 6, or 7, and if both 5 and 7 are present, then 0 or 6 must also be present.

Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=device turns on if object 1, 3, or 4 is present, or if two objects (excluding object 0) have indices summing to 6 (valid pairs: 1+5 or 2+4)

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6]; rule=device turns on if any added object is 2 or 3, or the sum of the numbers of the added objects is divisible by 3 (object 7 is already present)

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on when at least two of these objects are placed on it, but if both object 0 and object 2 are included, then at least one additional object from [object 1, object 6, object 7] must also be present
Announce: relevant=[object 0]; rule=device turns on if and only if object 0 is placed
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2]; rule=device is ON if object 0 is present or at least one of objects 1 or 2 is present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4]; rule=at least one of objects 0, 1, or 4 must be present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if any of object 0, object 1, or object 6 are present in the set; otherwise, it remains off
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4]; rule=the device turns on when at least one object whose number is a perfect square (0, 1, or 4) is placed on it.
